original.statement: The waypoint pod topologySpreadConstraints is now configurable via the new Helm value `.Values.global.waypoint.topologySpreadConstraints`.

decision.reason: [ev-c988c157ae16] says waypoint pod topologySpreadConstraints can now be set through `.Values.global.waypoint.topologySpreadConstraints`. The values files show the key is missing from 1.23.4 [ev-2139315891c3] and present in 1.24.0 [ev-257bea760fce]. So the only environments the change touches are those that set this key. The proposed exposure, values-key global.waypoint.topologySpreadConstraints set, says exactly that. Wrapping it in a one-operand "any" doesn't change its meaning. Confidence is low because the evidence doesn't state the exposure directly; it comes from the canonical shape for an added value.
